messages:
rachel: Heads-up: release cut blocked — artifact upload job is failing with corrupted tar chunks (checksum mismatch).
tony: Which job and registry?
rachel: Job 9021 -> staging registry. Logs show 'unexpected EOF while reading' and checksum mismatch during multipart upload.
ci-bot: Recent runs: 5/5 failed for this job in last 20m. Pattern points to parallel chunk assembly on the builder node.
qa-bot: Flake rate high; recommend temporary pin to last-green to avoid slipping the change window.
tony: We can either rebuild on a different builder pool or pin. Rebuild might take >2 hours. Change window is 45m.
rachel: Decision: manual promote previous image sha256:c0ffee00 to unblock. File follow-up infra ticket to investigate multipart uploader race.
deploybot: Manual promote to sha256:c0ffee00 accepted at 1758765560 by @rachel. Promo completed.
ci-bot: Kicking off background rebuild on alternate builder pool (job 9025) to validate artifacts; will report back.
qa-bot: Notifying release-managers and product: temporary pin applied; follow-up validation pending.
